CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_FINANCIALPRODUCT_TRU
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct
AS(
    SELECT
SCHM_CODE
SCHM_DESC
START_DATE
END_DATE
CUST_MIN_AGE
GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE
TRAN_RPT_CODE_FLG
TRAN_REF_NUM_FLG
SCHM_SUPR_USER_ID
NEW_ACCT_DURATION
DORM_ACCT_CRITERIA
FX_TRAN_FLG
STP_CR_DR_IND
FCNR_FLG
INT_PAID_COLL_CRNCY_FLG
INTER_SOL_CLOSURE_ALWD_FLG
ACCT_MAINT_PERIOD
MIN_COMMIT_CHRG_UTIL_PCNT
COMMIT_CALC_METHOD
INACTIVE_ACCT_CHRG_DAYS
INACTIVE_ACCT_CHRG_MNTHS
DORMANT_ACCT_CHRG_DAYS
DORMANT_ACCT_CHRG_MNTHS
PARTITION_MANDATORY_FLG
BOOK_TRAN_SCRIPT
INTCALC_TRAN_SCRIPT
DFLT_CLG_TRAN_CODE
DFLT_INST_TYPE
EEFC_FLG
CS_SCHM_MESG1
CS_SCHM_MESG2
COMP_DATE_FLG
FIXEDTERM_MNTHS
FIXEDTERM_YEARS
FLOAT_INT_TBL_CODE
FLOAT_REPRICING_FREQ_MNTHS
FLOAT_REPRICING_FREQ_DAYS
RULE_CODE
LOOKBACK_PERD_FOR_PASTDUE
BANK_ID
PEN_COLL_FLG
SCHM_NATURE
PS_FREQ_CAL_BASE
ADDITIONAL_CAL_BASE
MUD_POOL_PROD_FLG
ALT1_SCHM_SHORT_NAME
ALT1_SCHM_DESC
PRODUCT_SRL_NUM
PRODUCT_ID
ISLAMIC_PRODUCT_TYPE
ORG_CHNL_ID
SER_CHNL_ID
DEPOSIT_WINDOW_PERD
DEPOSIT_WIN_PERD_END_DATE
TOLERANCE_DEPOSIT_WIN_PERD
COOLING_PERIOD_MNTHS
COOLING_PERIOD_DAYS
PD_INDICATOR_FLG
FREEZ_INACTIVITY_PRD_MNTHS
FREEZ_INACTIVITY_PRD_DAYS
RPC_PURPOSE
    BTTD.RECORD_STATUS,
    BTT.INSERT_DTTM,
    BTT.BNK_CODE
    select * FROM BUSC.DEP_GENSCHMPARMTABLE_DELTA BTTD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_TRUPRODUCTS BTT ON BTT.PRODUCT_CODE = BTTD.PRODUCT_CODE AND BTT.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
PRODUCT_CODE,
PRODUCT_NAME,
PRODUCT_DESC,
MIN_AMT,
MAX_AMT,
MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
INV_TYPE, 
MIN_CURRENCY,
MAX_CURRENCY,
PROD_CLASS,
AUM_NOM,
REJECT_REASON,
BR_CD,
RESERVE_PER
)) HASHROW, PRODUCT_CODE, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
FinancialProductId,
FinancialProductName,
FinancialProductDescription,
ProductMinimumAmount,
ProductMaximumAmount,
ProductMinimumTerm,
InvestmentTypeId,
MinCurrencyCode,
MaxCurrencyCode,
ProductClass,
AumNom,
RejectReason,
BranchId,
ReservePercentage
)) HASHROW, FinancialProductId
FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR,
TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR,
ISNULL(SRC.PRODUCT_CODE, TGT.FinancialProductId) AS FinancialProductId,
CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_TGT TGT ON SRC.PRODUCT_CODE = TGT.FinancialProductId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
[FinancialProductId] = SRC.PRODUCT_CODE,
[FinancialProductName] = SRC.PRODUCT_NAME,
FinancialProductDescription = SRC.PRODUCT_DESC,
ProductShortDescription = NULL,
ProductInternalName = NULL,
ProductIntendedUse = NULL,
ProductIntroductionDate = NULL,
ProductFirstSaleDate = NULL,
PlannedAbandonmentDate = NULL,
ActualAbandonmentDate = NULL,
ProductMinimumAmount = SRC.MIN_AMT,
ProductMaximumAmount = SRC.MAX_AMT,
ProductMinimumTerm = SRC.MIN_HOLD_PERIOD,
ProductMaximumTerm = NULL,
UnitOfMeasureId = NULL,
NetContentUomId = NULL,
ProductNote = NULL,
PerAccountInsuranceLimitAmount = NULL,
InsuranceTypeId = NULL,
GoverningLawState = NULL,
CusipNumber = NULL,
GlobalTradeItemNumber = NULL,
GtinName = NULL,
EuropeanArticleNumber = NULL,
UniversalProductCode = NULL,
ItemElectronicProductCode = NULL,
ComponentPartIdentifier = NULL,
ProductInformationContactTelephoneNumber = NULL,
ProductInformationWwwUrl = NULL,
CustomerServiceTelephoneNumber = NULL,
PatentNumber = NULL,
PatentDate = NULL,
PatentExpirationDate = NULL,
Trademark = NULL,
ProductLogo = NULL,
CopyrightNumber = NULL,
CopyrightDate = NULL,
ProductLicenserName = NULL,
ProductExportRestrictionIndicator = NULL,
ProductExportRestrictionStartDate = NULL,
ProductExportRestrictionEndDate = NULL,
ProductExportRestrictionDescription = NULL,
ApprovalProcessStatement = NULL,
LegalDisclosureStatement = NULL,
PrivacyStatement = NULL,
InformationSharingStatement = NULL,
ProductAgreementCoverageStatement = NULL,
AcceptanceOfAgreementStatement = NULL,
RelationshipToOtherAgreementsStatement = NULL,
ProductUsageStatement = NULL,
ProductTermsAndConditionsStatement = NULL,
ProductChargesStatement = NULL,
PaymentCalculationStatement = NULL,
ProductServiceHoursStatement = NULL,
ChangesToAgreementStatement = NULL,
ServiceCancellationStatement = NULL,
DisclosureOfInformationStatement = NULL,
LimitationOfLiabilityStatement = NULL,
BankLiabilityStatement = NULL,
ServiceLimitationsStatement = NULL,
ChangesOrCancellationStatement = NULL,
MinimumAgeToOpenAccount = NULL,
MarketingMessageDescription = NULL,
[24HourInformationLineIndicator] = NULL,
OnLineBankingAvailableIndicator = NULL,
MonthlyStatementsIndicator = NULL,
AtmAccessIndicator = NULL,
PhoneBankingIndicator = NULL,
PrepaymentPenaltyIndicator = NULL,
AccelerationClauseIndicator = NULL,
ProductHasTrackingStatusAvailableIndicator = NULL,
AccountToAccountTransfersIndicator = NULL,
CoBrandedProductIndicator = NULL,
ResponsibilityCenterId = NULL,
CoBrandingOrganizationName = NULL,
ProductTypeId = NULL,
IsoCurrencyCode = NULL,
ProductInsuranceTypeId = NULL,
PrimaryBrandId = NULL,
WarrantyId = NULL,
PrimaryCountryOfOriginCountryId = NULL,
InvestmentTypeId = SRC.INV_TYPE,
MinCurrencyCode = SRC.MIN_CURRENCY,
MaxCurrencyCode = SRC.MAX_CURRENCY,
ProductClass = SRC.PROD_CLASS,
AumNom = SRC.AUM_NOM,
RejectReason = SRC.REJECT_REASON,
BranchId = SRC.BR_CD,
ReservePercentage = SRC.RESERVE_PER,
[SourceSystemCode] = 'TRU',
[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.BNK_CODE,
[WorkFlowId] = 0,
[TaskRunId] = 0,
[InsertDttm] = GETDATE()

FROM BNKM.FinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct SRC ON SRC.PRODUCT_CODE = TGT.FinancialProductId;


INSERT INTO BNKM.FinancialProduct(
FinancialProductId,
FinancialProductName,
FinancialProductDescription,
ProductShortDescription,
ProductInternalName,
ProductIntendedUse,
ProductIntroductionDate,
ProductFirstSaleDate,
PlannedAbandonmentDate,
ActualAbandonmentDate,
ProductMinimumAmount,
ProductMaximumAmount,
ProductMinimumTerm,
ProductMaximumTerm,
UnitOfMeasureId,
NetContentUomId,
ProductNote,
PerAccountInsuranceLimitAmount,
InsuranceTypeId,
GoverningLawState,
CusipNumber,
GlobalTradeItemNumber,
GtinName,
EuropeanArticleNumber,
UniversalProductCode,
ItemElectronicProductCode,
ComponentPartIdentifier,
ProductInformationContactTelephoneNumber,
ProductInformationWwwUrl,
CustomerServiceTelephoneNumber,
PatentNumber,
PatentDate,
PatentExpirationDate,
Trademark,
ProductLogo,
CopyrightNumber,
CopyrightDate,
ProductLicenserName,
ProductExportRestrictionIndicator,
ProductExportRestrictionStartDate,
ProductExportRestrictionEndDate,
ProductExportRestrictionDescription,
ApprovalProcessStatement,
LegalDisclosureStatement,
PrivacyStatement,
InformationSharingStatement,
ProductAgreementCoverageStatement,
AcceptanceOfAgreementStatement,
RelationshipToOtherAgreementsStatement,
ProductUsageStatement,
ProductTermsAndConditionsStatement,
ProductChargesStatement,
PaymentCalculationStatement,
ProductServiceHoursStatement,
ChangesToAgreementStatement,
ServiceCancellationStatement,
DisclosureOfInformationStatement,
LimitationOfLiabilityStatement,
BankLiabilityStatement,
ServiceLimitationsStatement,
ChangesOrCancellationStatement,
MinimumAgeToOpenAccount,
MarketingMessageDescription,
[24HourInformationLineIndicator],
OnLineBankingAvailableIndicator,
MonthlyStatementsIndicator,
AtmAccessIndicator,
PhoneBankingIndicator,
PrepaymentPenaltyIndicator,
AccelerationClauseIndicator,
ProductHasTrackingStatusAvailableIndicator,
AccountToAccountTransfersIndicator,
CoBrandedProductIndicator,
ResponsibilityCenterId,
CoBrandingOrganizationName,
ProductTypeId,
IsoCurrencyCode,
ProductInsuranceTypeId,
PrimaryBrandId,
WarrantyId,
PrimaryCountryOfOriginCountryId,
InvestmentTypeId,
MinCurrencyCode,
MaxCurrencyCode,
ProductClass,
AumNom,
RejectReason,
BranchId,
ReservePercentage,
SourceSystemCode,
FinancialInstitutionId,
WorkflowId,
TaskRunId,
InsertDttm)

SELECT
PRODUCT_CODE as FinancialProductId,
PRODUCT_NAME as FinancialProductName,
PRODUCT_DESC as FinancialProductDescription,
NULL AS ProductShortDescription,
NULL AS ProductInternalName,
NULL AS ProductIntendedUse,
NULL AS ProductIntroductionDate,
NULL AS ProductFirstSaleDate,
NULL AS PlannedAbandonmentDate,
NULL AS ActualAbandonmentDate,
MIN_AMT AS ProductMinimumAmount,
MAX_AMT AS ProductMaximumAmount,
MIN_HOLD_PERIOD AS ProductMinimumTerm,
NULL AS ProductMaximumTerm,
NULL AS UnitOfMeasureId,
NULL AS NetContentUomId,
NULL AS ProductNote,
NULL AS PerAccountInsuranceLimitAmount,
NULL AS InsuranceTypeId,
NULL AS GoverningLawState,
NULL AS CusipNumber,
NULL AS GlobalTradeItemNumber,
NULL AS GtinName,
NULL AS EuropeanArticleNumber,
NULL AS UniversalProductCode,
NULL AS ItemElectronicProductCode,
NULL AS ComponentPartIdentifier,
NULL AS ProductInformationContactTelephoneNumber,
NULL AS ProductInformationWwwUrl,
NULL AS CustomerServiceTelephoneNumber,
NULL AS PatentNumber,
NULL AS PatentDate,
NULL AS PatentExpirationDate,
NULL AS Trademark,
NULL AS ProductLogo,
NULL AS CopyrightNumber,
NULL AS CopyrightDate,
NULL AS ProductLicenserName,
NULL AS ProductExportRestrictionIndicator,
NULL AS ProductExportRestrictionStartDate,
NULL AS ProductExportRestrictionEndDate,
NULL AS ProductExportRestrictionDescription,
NULL AS ApprovalProcessStatement,
NULL AS LegalDisclosureStatement,
NULL AS PrivacyStatement,
NULL AS InformationSharingStatement,
NULL AS ProductAgreementCoverageStatement,
NULL AS AcceptanceOfAgreementStatement,
NULL AS RelationshipToOtherAgreementsStatement,
NULL AS ProductUsageStatement,
NULL AS ProductTermsAndConditionsStatement,
NULL AS ProductChargesStatement,
NULL AS PaymentCalculationStatement,
NULL AS ProductServiceHoursStatement,
NULL AS ChangesToAgreementStatement,
NULL AS ServiceCancellationStatement,
NULL AS DisclosureOfInformationStatement,
NULL AS LimitationOfLiabilityStatement,
NULL AS BankLiabilityStatement,
NULL AS ServiceLimitationsStatement,
NULL AS ChangesOrCancellationStatement,
NULL AS MinimumAgeToOpenAccount,
NULL AS MarketingMessageDescription,
NULL AS [24HourInformationLineIndicator],
NULL AS OnLineBankingAvailableIndicator,
NULL AS MonthlyStatementsIndicator,
NULL AS AtmAccessIndicator,
NULL AS PhoneBankingIndicator,
NULL AS PrepaymentPenaltyIndicator,
NULL AS AccelerationClauseIndicator,
NULL AS ProductHasTrackingStatusAvailableIndicator,
NULL AS AccountToAccountTransfersIndicator,
NULL AS CoBrandedProductIndicator,
NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId,
NULL AS CoBrandingOrganizationName,
NULL AS ProductTypeId,
NULL AS IsoCurrencyCode,
NULL AS ProductInsuranceTypeId,
NULL AS PrimaryBrandId,
NULL AS WarrantyId,
NULL AS PrimaryCountryOfOriginCountryId,
INV_TYPE as InvestmentTypeId,
MIN_CURRENCY AS MinCurrencyCode,
MAX_CURRENCY AS MaxCurrencyCode,
PROD_CLASS AS ProductClass,
AUM_NOM AS AumNom,
REJECT_REASON AS RejectReason,
BR_CD AS BranchId,
RESERVE_PER AS ReservePercentage,
'TRU' AS SourceSystemCode,
BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId,
0 AS WORKFLOWID,
0 AS TASKRUNID,
INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProduct_DELTA;

END
